Question: Coin Change (Minimum Coins)

You are given:

N types of coins

Each coin has a denomination coin[i]

An integer Amount

You may use each coin unlimited times.

Determine the minimum number of coins required to make the given amount.

If it is not possible, print:

-1

Input Format
N Amount
c1 c2 c3 ... cN

Output Format

Print a single integer —
minimum number of coins required, or -1 if impossible.
